Policy intent queue
Queued — executed by the LOCAL worker on this node, not by this page: node scripts/arcblog-economy.mjs policy apply (once) or policy watch (keep running). Until that worker runs, the policy shown above is still the old one.
One record per click under config/policy-intents. A click NEVER changes the policy itself: the node's local worker performs it (node scripts/arcblog-economy.mjs policy apply, or policy watch) and writes its outcome — status + reason — back onto the record.
pending = queued, not run yet · running = claimed by the worker · applied = the policy really changed · rejected = refused, zero change · noop = already in that state, zero bytes written
